description:
Defines a working-hours schedule precisely: what it means, whether it genuinely reduces weekly hours, whether that reduction is at full pay, the typical hours, and — where one is commonly made — the mistake most often made about it.

Call it when the user's question turns on what a schedule means, for example whether a compressed 4x10 counts as a 4-day week, or whether a schedule is at full pay. A compressed 4x10 gives four days but not fewer hours, and is not a 4-day week. Omitting the argument returns every definition at once.

schedule_type.description: A schedule_type value, e.g. 4_day_week or compressed_week. Omit to get every definition.
